file: # Exchange icons: preserve the diagrams and arrows above the captions.
# Short shop buttons: 64x32 OBJ sprites, 24-pixel-high visible frames.
# Wide shop buttons: 64 tiles = two 64x32 OBJs side by side (@8x4 = one 128x32 image); frame interior 98x17 at 3,3.
# Their Japanese is the 12 px font, so the English is too (網膜鑑定 Retinal Appraisal is 108 px: Appraisal).
# Body-part (uptake slot) buttons: 96x48 map files, the kanji sits at 7-27 x 11-20 on a gradient; labels from the
# glossary (Head / Torso / Right Arm / Left Arm / Right Leg / Left Leg), left-aligned where the kanji started.
